title: chrysothamnus viscidiflorus var. humilis
intro: Chrysothamnus viscidiflorus var. humilis, commonly known as Rocky Mountain chamomile or dwarf chamomile, is a low-growing perennial plant native to the western United States. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to promote relaxation and reduce anxiety due to its health benefits, which include soothing digestive issues and calming the nervous system. The therapeutic actions of Chrysothamnus viscidiflorus var. humilis include its sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it useful for treating insomnia, restlessness, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its use as a natural remedy for various health issues.
